status_vocabulary.DONE: built as the board draws it; evidence cites the code
status_vocabulary.BUG: wrong or dishonest output today; failure_scenario says how
status_vocabulary.GAP: board element missing; no owner decision needed; size S/M/L
status_vocabulary.DEVIATION: built differently on purpose; the reasoning is recorded in code or docs (cited)
status_vocabulary.OWNER: needs an owner decision (policy, schema, or spec vs settled evidence)
status_vocabulary.NOT_BUILDABLE: the data does not exist (AO3 or app); cited

boards.title: Search results
boards.spec_label: Fandom-hue wash; floating chrome (back, query pill, accent filter button with its count, overflow); kicker / rule / 32pt hero with the sort as a dropdown beside the fandom; four-cell stat strip; active filters as a chip rail with a dashed Filter; ledger rows with inline expand chevron, summary and meta line; paging switcher pill and page sheet.

items.what: Kicker 'Search results', 32pt total, subject + sort dropdown, four-cell strip (Works / Filters / Pages / Page)
items.note: Every cell is sourced: Works is AO3's own heading, Pages AO3's pagination, Filters the app's own filter set. The sort label prints the Sort case title ('Date Updated'), where the board words it 'Newest updates first'.

items.what: Chip rail of active filters with a dashed Filter pinned at the end
Full-bleed wash and floating 34pt chrome instead of a navigation bar
items.note: Search is a tab root and keeps its bar; the wash is drawn at 600pt under it. Reason recorded at the call site.

items.what: Accent filter button carries its count
items.note: FilterButton already takes badgeCount (the Library/Home section lists pass it); Search passes none.
items.fix: badgeCount: filters.summaryLabels(includesSort: false).count (or excluding the subject, matching the hero's own count).
items.test: Pure: the badge count equals SearchResultsHero's 'Filters' cell for the same filters.

items.what: Ledger rows: kicker + inline expand chevron, rule, title, byline, 2x2 grid, summary, meta line; expand reveals tag groups
Paging switcher pill and page sheet (field, ten tiles, First/Last)
items.note: Pill + PageJumpSheet (field, nearbyPageWindow tiles, First/Last, staged confirm, detents [.height(430), .large]). Re-read in the critic pass.

items.what: Retry after a failed page load
items.failure_scenario: On page 4, tap page 5 and the request fails: the old page stays behind a 'Search failed' overlay, and 'Try Again' calls runSearch(), which resets currentPage to 1 and loads page 1. The reader asked for page 5 and is sent to page 1.
items.fix: Remember the requested page in load(page:) (e.g. pendingPage) and have Try Again call load(page: pendingPage ?? currentPage) when results are already on screen; keep runSearch for the first-load failure.
items.test: Pure decision: retryPage(requested: 5, current: 4, hasResults: true) == 5; hasResults false -> 1.

boards.title: Refine
boards.spec_label: Same panel narrowing loaded works; query-only facets gone; tick instead of magnifier; live count above the form.

items.what: Query-only facets hidden, tick button, live 'N of M on this page match'
'Include Not Rated' shown as a live control in Refine while Rating is Any
items.failure_scenario: In Refine with Rating on Any, the panel draws 'Include Not Rated' as an ordinary toggle. Switching it off changes nothing and the live 'N of M on this page match' line does not move, because Refine deliberately ignores the toggle until a rating is chosen (ratingMatches returns early; pinned by AO3SummaryFilterRatingTests.notRatedToggleIsInertUntilARatingIsChosen). A control that visibly does nothing.
items.note: Corrected by the critic pass: this was first filed as 'Refine ignores the toggle', which is a pinned decision, not a bug; and the 'No Not Rated' chip only renders on Search/Browse heroes, where the filter is real.
items.fix: In .refine mode, show the toggle only when filters.rating != .any. Do not change the matcher - the test pins its rule.
items.test: Pure: AO3FilterPanel.showsIncludeNotRated(mode: .refine, rating: .any) == false; (.refine, .teen) == true; (.search, .any) == true.

items.what: Search and Refine disagree on Include Not Rated under Rating Any
items.note: Search sends -rating_ids:9 when the toggle is off and Rating is Any, so Not Rated works disappear; Refine keeps them (pinned by test). The Rating picker also turns the toggle off when leaving Any and never back on, so a reader who tried Teen and returned to Any keeps excluding Not Rated in Search. One rule for both modes is the owner's pick.
